title: Who is built first?
description:
Write two classes, `Base` and `Derived` (which inherits from `Base`). Each constructor and destructor appends to the global string `g_log`:

| Function | Appends |
|---|---|
| `Base` constructor | `"+Base "` |
| `Derived` constructor | `"+Derived "` |
| `Derived` destructor | `"-Derived "` |
| `Base` destructor | `"-Base "` |

Then creating and destroying one `Derived` object produces `+Base +Derived -Derived -Base `: the base part is built first, like a foundation, and demolished last.
